verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents creating a custom avatar of a real person, either 'yourself from a single photo' or a personal/branded avatar. The pack documents no consent or verification flow for avatars. The only consent reference covers voice cloning, a different capability, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented avatar consent capture, identity verification of the depicted person, flow steps or requirements for avatars of others, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow

citations.quote: Create an avatar of yourself from a single photo, for more personal videos.
Create a personal or branded AI avatar that can present video content without repeated filming.
